result.description: A fictional compact 27-inch studio display designed for color-accurate office illustration, photo proofing, and daylong text work rather than gaming or workstation graphics. It features a 2560 x 1440 IPS panel, factory-calibrated sRGB and Display P3 modes, a matte anti-glare surface, and a height-adjustable stand with USB-C laptop input and built-in USB hub for desk setup convenience. The Aurora S3 is positioned as a quiet, low-power creative monitor with a warm neutral color profile and a three-year limited warranty.
result.title: LumaForge Aurora S3 Studio Monitor
